uncited: **Edge Crossing Detection**: Identify which edges of the cube are intersected by the isosurface.
- Intersection coordinates are computed using linear interpolation on the respective components of the modified field function.
**Normal Sampling**: Sample the normal vectors at each edge crossing point.
- For each edge, check if both start and end vertices are in the `features` set.
- **Feature Threshold**: Angle threshold for detecting sharp features.
